name: Prague
summary: See Charles Bridge and the castle at the edges of the day and spend the busy middle hours in quieter quarters. The centre is compact but cobbled and hilly.
seasonNote: Summer and December market season are packed; January to March is cold and quiet.
arrival: A trolleybus and the metro take about 45 minutes from the airport; use official taxi stands or apps.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; trams are frequent and tram 22 is a sightseeing ride in itself.
cashTip: Pay by card or use bank ATMs; avoid street exchange offices and decline card conversion.
foodTip: Try svíčková, roast pork knuckle, fried cheese and a properly poured tank pilsner.
buyTip: Bohemian glass, garnet from certified shops and wooden toys; skip the generic souvenir chains.
baseArea: Old Town edge, Malá Strana or Vinohrady

connections.note: Direct Railjet trains every two hours.
Direct trains by day; a flight takes about an hour.
